yt.title: An AI that was always right... or was it?
notes: Task: tell a husky from a wolf in a photo
It got the answers right on its test
Then researchers asked: what is it looking at?

lines.text: Researchers ఒక AI ని తయారు చేశారు... husky కి, wolf కి తేడా చెప్పగలిగే AI. [1] తర్వాత, అది అసలు ఏం చూస్తోందో check చేశారు. [2] అది animal ని చూడట్లేదు.
lines.show: Researchers built an AI that could tell a husky from a wolf. Then they checked what it was actually looking at. It wasn't the animal.

yt.title: It learned a shortcut
notes: Training wolves: almost all in snow
Training huskies: almost all on grass
Shortcut learned: snow means wolf
Husky in snow → predicted WOLF

lines.text: అది snow ని చూస్తోంది. [1] Training photos లో, దాదాపు ప్రతి wolf snow లోనే ఉంది... [2] ప్రతి husky, grass మీద. [3] So AI ఒక shortcut నేర్చుకుంది: snow ఉంటే, wolf. [4] ఇప్పుడు snow లో ఉన్న husky ని చూపిస్తే... [5] wolf అంటుంది.
lines.show: It was looking at the snow. In the training photos, almost every wolf stood in snow... and every husky, on grass. So the AI learned a shortcut: snow means wolf. Show it a husky in the snow... wolf.

yt.title: Garbage in, garbage out
notes: A model only learns patterns its data shows
Biased or messy data → biased, wrong answers
More training can't fix bad data

lines.text: ఇదే AI golden rule. [1] Garbage in... [2] garbage out. [3] Data లో ఏం చూపిస్తే, model అదే నేర్చుకుంటుంది.
lines.show: This is the golden rule of AI. Garbage in... garbage out. A model can only learn what its data shows it.

yt.title: Four things good data needs
notes: Quantity: enough examples to learn from
Quality: correct labels, no junk or duplicates
Diversity: every place, person and situation
Freshness: data that matches today's world

lines.text: మరి good data కి ఏం కావాలి? [1] Quantity: సరిపడా examples. [2] Quality: సరైన labels, junk ఉండకూడదు. [3] Diversity: grass మీద wolves కూడా, అన్ని skin tones ఉన్న faces కూడా. [4] ఇంకా Freshness... data పాతది కాకూడదు.
lines.show: So what makes data good? Quantity: enough examples. Quality: correct labels, no junk. Diversity: wolves on grass too, and faces of every skin tone. And freshness... so the world hasn't moved on.

yt.title: Train, validation, test
notes: Train set (~80%): the model learns from it
Validation set (~10%): tune settings
Test set (~10%): hidden until the very end
Score on unseen data = real performance

lines.text: Cheating AI ని పట్టుకోవాలంటే... [1] కొంత data ని దాచిపెడతాం. [2] ఎక్కువ data తో train చేస్తాం. [3] కొంచెం data తో tune చేస్తాం. [4] ఇంతవరకు చూడని photos తో test చేస్తాం. [5] ఒక surprise exam లాగా.
lines.show: And to catch a cheating AI... we hide some data away. Train on most of it. Tune on a little. And test on photos it has never seen. A surprise exam.

data.question: An AI spots cats perfectly... but only indoors. Which rule did its data break?

yt.title: Crack this case
notes: An AI spots cats perfectly... only indoors
Which data rule did it break?
Answer: Diversity

lines.text: ఇప్పుడు మీ turn, detective. ఒక AI cats ని perfect గా గుర్తిస్తుంది... కానీ ఇంట్లో మాత్రమే. [1] దాని data, ఏ rule break చేసింది? <pause 2> [2] Diversity! అది బయట ఉన్న cat ని ఎప్పుడూ చూడలేదు.
lines.show: Your turn, detective. An AI spots cats perfectly... but only indoors. Which rule did its data break? Diversity! It never saw a cat outdoors.

points: Good data: quantity, quality, diversity, freshness
Always test on data it has never seen

yt.title: An AI is only as smart as its data
notes: Garbage in, garbage out
Check quantity, quality, diversity, freshness
Always test on data it has never seen

lines.text: Case closed. [1] AI ఎంత smart అనేది, దాని data మీదే ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది. [2] Next: ప్రతి answer బట్టీ పట్టిన AI... అయినా exam fail అయింది. Miss అవ్వకుండా, follow చేయండి.
lines.show: Case closed. An AI is only as smart as its data. Next: the AI that memorised every answer... and still failed the exam. Follow, so you don't miss it.
